description: Use when you need natural-hazard context for a site by latitude/longitude: active NWS alerts at the point (US only), USGS earthquakes and open NASA EONET events. Returns the paid x402 request for your input (GET /hazards/near, $0.005 per call; schema linked). Call that URL with an x402 or MPP client to get the data. Bad input is refused before any charge. One site only; for up to 10 sites in one call use hazards_near_batch; for a weather forecast use weather. With an access key (Authorization: Bearer p0k_..., buy at https://x402-bazaar-rank.x402-bazaar-rank-worker.workers.dev/keys/buy?usd=5) the tool pays the call itself, returns the data and deducts the price. First call each day returns the data itself, free; later calls return the paid request.

km.description: Search radius in km for earthquakes and EONET events (NWS alerts are for the point itself), 1..500 (default 100)
